{{Quote|Don't let them get away!|Flask after seeing Anakin, Obi-Wan and Dooku escaping|<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
'''Dagu Flask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and a member of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was kidnapped by the pirate gang, and they demanded a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] ransom from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in exchange for the Count. The Republic sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate base]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to confirm the capture of Dooku. [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], the leader of the gang, was eager to triple the ransom, so he captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] too.<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the Jedi tried to escape on many an occasion, but were recaptured each time.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

During one such escape, the prisoners attempted to escape by pole-vaulting over the wall of the pirate outpost. They succeeded only partially, with Skywalker clinging to the edge of the wall, while Kenobi and Dooku held on to his legs. Meanwhile Flask and several other [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] opened fire upon the escapees. Anakin couldn't hold on any longer and told Kenobi to drop Dooku. Suddenly, Flask ordered a cease-fire. Ohnaka was then standing on the wall, and told his men to arrest the prisoners.<ref name="The Gungan General" />

[[20 BBY/Legends|Two years later]],<ref name="BBY">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' (2014)]] [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44|Part 44]] {{C|20 BBY 47–50, ''Maul on Mandalore''}}</ref> Dagu fought alongside Hondo against their own pirates that defected to side with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in their conquest for power. He was killed during the [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish]] after trying to defend the base and was shot to death.<ref name="REV">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Flask was a master [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. He had a lot of experience with [[Weequay blaster lance/Legends|blaster rifles]].<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref>
